text:
ava: Quick sync — Hyperspire POC asking to run their custom model on Dedicated. They need KV cache + KMS and a 99.5% latency SLA. Who owns compatibility checks?

devon: I can take the lead on model fit. Do we have the model artifact details? size, tokenizer, precisions?

ava: They shared: hyperspire-xl-30b-qat, tokenizer=bpe-64k, quantized to 4bit per docs. They want persistent KV across warm starts.

liam: 4-bit QAT + persistent KV is usually fine, but need to validate memory layout and kernel selection. I'll run a quick compatibility matrix. Any constraints on sequence length?

ava: Typical seq len 2048 for chat, but POC will test up to 4096. Also multi-tenant routing not allowed — they want single-tenant pool.

liam: Single-tenant makes autoscale simpler. For 4096 we need to confirm shard strategy; running perf probe now: `runtest --model hyperspire-xl-30b-qat --seq 4096 --batch 1`

deploy-bot: Deployment probe queued: job_id=hp-6147-01 status=queued

devon: Also flagged pricing — they asked for committed Dedicated price + overage rates. Sales propose 6mo reserved at 60% discount vs on-demand. Ava, can you confirm?

ava: That's the baseline. We may need to tie discount to a throughput commit (tokens/day). I'll share numbers with the buyer.

sofia: Security note: they require KMS + HSM-level key isolation and an NDA for model weights. Need to know if Private deployment is mandatory or if Dedicated (hosted) with BYOK meets requirements.

liam: Dedicated with BYOK to customer KMS/HSM is supported, but we need to enable key wrapping. Also must record audit logs for all decrypt ops. Ops checklist: enable KMS integration, set kms_key_id, enable audit retention=365d.

devon: For model onboarding, request from Infra: model file (f32/bfloat fallback), quant metadata, tokenizer files, and a minimal prompt set for eval.

ava: I'll ask the buyer for artifacts and SSQ (security self-questionnaire). Sofia, can you draft the answers for our standard SSQ v3 with the HSM addendum?

sofia: Yep — I'll start a template and call out L4 controls for key management and network isolation. Expect draft by EOD.

liam: Probe results: initial run shows OOM at 4096 with batch1 unless we enable KV sharding + swap-to-ssd. Need to confirm if customer accepts slight latency penalty for >2048.

devon: If we enable prefix KV caching and sharding, we can keep tail-latency under SLA for most traffic. Send the perf numbers and proposed tradeoffs to the buyer.

ava: Will do. Action items: 1) Ava request artifacts + SSQ, 2) Devon run model eval with sample prompts, 3) Liam complete compatibility matrix and perf notes, 4) Sofia draft SSQ responses.

deploy-bot: Reminder: create POC ticket in /projects/hyperspire and tag `poc:dedicated`

ava: Thanks — I'll loop in finance for committed pricing and legal for NDA.

devon: One more ask from buyer: can we support variant fallback to a 13b distilled model if capacity constrained? That affects routing and evals.

liam: Fallback supported via routing policy; we need to onboard a compatible 13b variant and ensure tokenizer parity. Add to model catalog tasks.

ava: Great. I'll update the buyer with timeline: prelim compatibility & SSQ by EOD tomorrow, perf + pricing within 3 business days.

sofia: Noted. If they need penetration testing, we should schedule with SecOps — could add 2 weeks to timeline.

ava: Cool — keeping buyer informed. Ping me for any blockers. :thumbsup:
